source: 2026-10-13 Web历史测试失败逐项修复：原36项逐项核对；导航12项沿用e1c89463当前契约并补Logo／异步拒绝／失败重试，剩余24项修复测试适配或功能。全量0失败，历史例外集合清零；任一新增失败仍禁止发布。详见specs/2026-10-13-Web历史测试失败逐项修复.md
resolvedFailures: customer-service dispatch keeps station assignment while station page is wired for personnel assignment
business create and edit forms use the shared dialog shell
catalog uploads use the official Gaia access and download addresses
category detail shows readable ancestry and never exposes a raw parent ID as its name
dialog tab tables use one lightweight visual shell without replacing table behavior
editable controls in shared business form dialogs provide placeholders
every built-in navigation identifier has paired titles; unknown and custom names remain unchanged
installation code API permission is independent from purchase record permission and missing grants fail closed
installation code list failure exposes retry without repeating successful permission requests
installation code page retries permission initialization before requesting business data
installation code search, paging and reset query once and preserve the applied keyword
inventory stock range uses a complete non-clearable select instead of a switch
inventory tabs only expose readable views and keep the active view in the route
network create dialogs open before optional option data is requested
page tabs use the shared lightweight visual hierarchy
product instances always expose details and show the purchase-registration state
product instances show factory and warehouse codes and reserve both sync actions
purchase registration edit form keeps the selected store and groups installation codes
purchase registration follows the shared list toolbar and form dialog standard
purchase registration keeps workbench items focused while the full page still supports supplied installation codes
raw view dialogs are limited to reviewed non-standard interaction models
real payloads whitelist fields and preserve false filters and optimistic versions
registration and appointment payloads whitelist and normalize business fields
